properties.title: The domain reaches the Kuroshio
properties.message: If an edge of the domain lies across the Kuroshio, make the current cross it at right angles: where a strong current enters an open boundary at a steep angle, it reflects and causes artifacts.
properties.instruction: Check where the Kuroshio meets the domain's edges. Move an edge, or rotate the grid (mom6_forge's Grid.from_center with angle_deg), so the current crosses it squarely.

references.title: Expert interview 1: Coral Triangle & Benguela Upwelling

evidence.quote: Open boundary conditions are more stable when energetic currents cross them perpendicularly.
Rotating your domain so that the main current crosses the boundary perpendicularly helps a lot.
